facts_found: Business Bronze Rewards Card has a $0.00 annual fee and earns 1.0% cash back on eligible purchases. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_bronze_rewards_card_001]

Business Bronze Rewards Card eligibility requires a minimum personal FICO score of 660; a PAYDEX score of 20 or higher is helpful but not required for new businesses. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_bronze_rewards_card_001]
Business Bronze Rewards Card initial credit lines range from at least $10,000 to as high as $50,000 based on underwriting. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_bronze_rewards_card_005]

Business Bronze Rewards Card new-customer promo: spend $10,000 in the first 2 months to receive a $500 statement credit; returns and credits reduce qualifying spend. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_bronze_rewards_card_001]
Business Bronze Rewards Card APR on carried balances is 20.49%. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_bronze_rewards_card_001]

Business Bronze Rewards Card excludes specific merchants from cash back, including WeWork, Regus, Industrious, Gusto, ADP, Paychex, Rippling, and certain SaaS renewals after 12 months. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_bronze_rewards_card_003]
Business Silver Rewards Card annual fee is $122.50, with a first-year promotional annual fee of $0 for new customers. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_001]

Business Silver Rewards Card eligibility requires a minimum personal FICO score of 700; established businesses may qualify based on a PAYDEX score of at least 47. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_001]
Business Silver Rewards Card approved credit limits generally range from $17,500 to $112,500. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_001]
Business Silver Rewards Card earns 10.0% cash back on eligible travel and software purchases and 1.0% cash back on all other purchases. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_002]

Business Silver Rewards Card had a limited-time double-cash-back promo for new customers opening between 2024-11-14 and 2025-11-14, doubling rates for the first 6 months after account opening. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012]
Business Gold Rewards Card annual fee is $200.00 and APR for carried balances is 17.99%. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_gold_rewards_card_001]
Business Gold Rewards Card eligibility requires a minimum personal credit score of 735 and a minimum PAYDEX score of 67. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_gold_rewards_card_001]
Business Gold Rewards Card initial credit limits start at $37,500 and may reach up to $225,000. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_gold_rewards_card_001]

Business Gold Rewards Card earns 2.5% cash back on operations spending and 1.0% cash back on other purchases; rewards depend on the merchant category code assigned by the merchant's payment processor. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_gold_rewards_card_002]

Business Gold operations spend examples include utilities, telecommunications, cloud services/software, shipping/postage/logistics, office supplies, routine maintenance, and professional services; non-qualifying examples include cash-like transactions, peer-to-peer transfers, debt repayments, entertainment, personal, or non-business transactions. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_gold_rewards_card_003]

Business Platinum Rewards Card eligibility requires a minimum personal credit score of 765 and a minimum PAYDEX score of 77 for established businesses. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_platinum_rewards_card_001]
Business Platinum Rewards Card credit limits range from $75,000 to $400,000 and carried-balance APR is 16.99%. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_platinum_rewards_card_001]

Business Platinum Rewards Card earns 4.0% cash back on travel, software, and media advertising purchases and 1.5% cash back on other purchases. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_platinum_rewards_card_002]
Business Platinum Rewards Card does not earn cash back on cash equivalents, balance transfers, or fees. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_platinum_rewards_card_002]
Green Rewards Card annual fee is $100.00, purchase APR is 19.99%, and foreign transaction fee is 1.0%. [doc_business_credit_cards_green_rewards_card_001]
Green Rewards Card eligibility requires a minimum personal FICO threshold of 690 and, for established businesses, a PAYDEX threshold of 42. [doc_business_credit_cards_green_rewards_card_001]
Green Rewards Card approved credit lines range from $14,000 to $75,000. [doc_business_credit_cards_green_rewards_card_001]
Green Rewards Card earns 3.0% cash back at sustainable/eco-friendly merchants and 1.0% cash back on other eligible purchases. [doc_business_credit_cards_green_rewards_card_004]
Green Rewards Card ineligible purchases include cash equivalents, balance transfers, and certain fees. [doc_business_credit_cards_green_rewards_card_004]

Silver Zoom Card is designed for established transportation and logistics businesses and requires personal credit at or above 680 and business credit at or above 57 on the PAYDEX scale for logistics business approval. [doc_business_credit_cards_silver_zoom_card_008]
Silver Zoom Card annual membership fee is $74.50 and carried-balance APR is 20.99%. [doc_business_credit_cards_silver_zoom_card_008]
Silver Zoom Card approved credit lines range from $22,500 to $175,000. [doc_business_credit_cards_silver_zoom_card_008]

Silver Zoom Card earns 3.0% on sector-specific spend and 1.0% on other eligible purchases, and provides a recurring 10.0% fuel price reduction at participating stations. [doc_business_credit_cards_silver_zoom_card_001]
Silver Zoom Card has a new-customer fuel financing promotion of 0% APR on fuel purchases for the first year, subject to eligibility and timing rules. [doc_business_credit_cards_silver_zoom_card_001]
Silver Zoom Card driver cards can have daily spending caps at or below $1,250. [doc_business_credit_cards_silver_zoom_card_009]

Rho-Bank reward categories include travel, software, media, green/sustainable, operations, transportation, shopping, and other; each card has its own bonus categories and non-bonus purchases earn the card's default rate. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_005]
Large purchases may be declined by fraud protection even when available credit exists; customers should contact support if a transaction is declined. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_023]

For Business Bronze, customers should monitor available credit before initiating large transactions and pay down balances proactively to free available credit. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_bronze_rewards_card_005]
